name: krx-craft-websquare
description: KRX_Craft WebSquare (Inswave RIA) pages — gcc/ins/mgt/stf XML tree — with ESLint + Jest + wsxml_lint toolchain.

scripts.lint:xml: npm run lint:xml:gcc && npm run lint:xml:legacy
scripts.lint:xml:legacy: python -m wsxml_lint cm/as-is/ins cm/as-is/mgt cm/as-is/stf cm/as-is/fil --ignore WS111,WS112,WS113
scripts.docs:gcc: python -m wsxml_lint.docgen cm/gcc -o cm/docs/api/gcc --title "gcc API 문서"
scripts.docs:pcc:stf: python -m wsxml_lint.docgen cm/pcc/stf -o cm/docs/api/stf --title "pcc stf 업무공통 API 문서"
scripts.docs:pcc:fil: python -m wsxml_lint.docgen cm/pcc/fil -o cm/docs/api/fil --title "pcc fil 업무공통 API 문서"
scripts.docs:pcc:mgt: python -m wsxml_lint.docgen cm/pcc/mgt -o cm/docs/api/mgt --title "pcc mgt 업무공통 API 문서"
scripts.docs:pcc:tms: python -m wsxml_lint.docgen cm/pcc/tms -o cm/docs/api/tms --title "pcc tms 업무공통 API 문서"
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:wsxml && npm run lint:xml
